## F — Verify list, Chapter Five, the graduated driver license program

Consolidated VERIFY index for the Chapter Five, the graduated driver license program dossier. Open items: sec02-D01 (official exam facts unknown in the safe view; passing percentage and time limit not stated on the licensing pages), sec02-D02 (market-signal pack not researched; no competitive intelligence supplied). Every knowledge fact in parts C and C2 carries high confidence with one cited handbook page and no verify flag; no fact statement contains a withheld value. No external review request was raised because no rule in the section requires legal, clinical or safety review beyond the issuer's own text. Competitive teardown is a scoped disposition in E2, not a debt.

corpus_stability.reason: The Vermont Driver's Manual is a single pinned edition (Vermont Driver’s Manual 2025; VN-007 07/2024 MTC) revised no more than once a year by the issuer; no faster-changing corpus feeds this section.
